name: Barcode Scanner
tagline: A text field with a device barcode/QR scan button.

limitations: The scan button calls context.device.getBarcodeValue(), which the demo sandbox always rejects (no device APIs behind that origin) — scanning shows the control's own no-camera state instead of a real result
Typing a value directly into the field still works, since that path never touches context.device

presets.name: Default
presets.description: An empty field, ready to type into or attempt a scan.

presets.name: Already scanned
presets.description: Shows the field's post-scan state without needing a working scanner.
